methods.failure_signature: The first planning invocation used CommonJS require inside an .mjs entrypoint and stopped before writing any phase file.
methods.candidate_workaround: Use node: imports and derive the directory from import.meta.url.
methods.recurrence_guard: Run node --check and use ESM-native imports for .mjs lifecycle builders.
methods.rollback: No generated phase files existed; retain the invocation failure and patch only the module boundary.

methods.title: File-backed planning preflight

methods.candidate_workaround: Move the validator into an owner-scoped .mjs file and invoke it without shell-interpreted source text.
methods.recurrence_guard: Use file-backed validators when JavaScript contains regular expressions or shell-significant punctuation.
methods.rollback: No validation or repository mutation occurred; retain the wrapper failure and run only the file-backed recovery.
